TEM investigation, based on the assessment of SADPs taken in <001>bcc zone axes and the intensity line profiles along the g200 vector (which showed no local maxima at their half-lengths), confirmed the bcc structure in the NbTiZr and Al2.5(NbTiZr)97.5 alloys (Figures 1(e,f,i,j)).
we detected diffuse and faint 100B2 superlattice spots in the Al5(NbTiZr)95 alloy (denoted with pink arrows in Figure 1(g)).
These B2 superlattice spots were sharper and brighter in the Al7.5(NbTiZr)92.5 alloy (Figure 1(h)).

EBSD analysis revealed a fully recrystallised microstructure in all the alloys (Figures 1(a-d)). Average grain sizes were close to ∼20 μm; however, small deviations from this mean value should be noted (Figure S1, Supplementary material).
The threshold segmentation (Figures 2(c, d)) suggested the average size, d̄, standard deviation, σ, and fraction, f, of these B2 domains as 0.82, 0.33 nm, and ∼20%, respectively (Figure 2(e)).
